text:
jordan: Heads-up: we need to finalise the UI + API contract for producing "full audit bundles" on demand. Current console shows a compact activity stream but customers want guaranteed retrievability for compliance requests.
nina: Two constraints: 1) don't blow daily export quotas, 2) preserve ability to prove chain-of-custody (who approved, who downloaded).
tom: Proposal: export endpoint /v1/audit/export that accepts {tenant, window, redaction_mode, justification_id}. It returns a job id and ETA. Job creation counts against tenant export quota.
ajr: small nit: call it justification_id or approval_ref? approval_ref maps to approval workflow.
jordan: Good point. We'll standardise on approval_ref. Also need an audit log entry for the export request itself (actor, approval_ref, requested_ttl).
security: For chain-of-custody we need these fields in the bundle manifest as plaintext: manifest_id, created_by, created_at, approval_ref, sampling_policy_id, redaction_mode. The bundle itself can pseudonymize actor ids, but manifest must map salted hashes to original IDs in an inner-key encrypted envelope accessible only to legal.
nina: UX: in the activity rail, when events are sampled we show an inline pill "partial history (sampled)" with a tooltip explaining sampling ratio and a link "Request full history". That link triggers the export flow and performs entitlement checks.
tom: Implementation: sampling_policy header in NDJSON bundles. Example: `{"_meta":{"sampling":{"id":"sp-2026-03","ratio":0.05,"reason":"cost-control"}}}` then per-line events. Keep header as single JSON line.
jordan: Also support an opt-in for tenants to keep full-fidelity for specific namespaces (e.g., routing.*) — toggled by admin, still billed.
security: On download: require KMS-managed envelope encryption for the manifest that maps salted hashes to real actor ids. Store download audit events: {actor, ip, user_agent, manifest_id, timestamp}.
ajr: Quotas: we should expose remaining monthly export credits in the console and via /v1/quotas endpoint. Also a soft-fail behavior: if tenant exhausted credits, show "Request will be queued" or "pay to expedite".
nina: Edge case: export contains PII in justification text. Add server-side scrubber with config: redact_patterns + allowlist fields. The export job should record which scrubber version ran.
tom: Rollout plan: feature flag gating + phased rollout. Phase 1: enable for internal tenants only. Phase 2: 25 beta tenants. Phase 3: open opt-in.
export-bot: feature-flag "full-audit-export" enabled for internal-orgs at 2026-03-22T11:00:00Z
jordan: Action items: tom -> API PR + NDJSON header; nina -> mock for pill + export CTA + quota panel; security -> pseudonymization + manifest encryption spec; infra -> quota endpoints + job queue metrics.
security: I'll draft the manifest schema and pseudonymisation recommendations and share before EOD.
jordan: Let's meet tomorrow 09:00 to go over API shape. Meeting created: https://calendar.redwood.ai/meeting/def456
